notes.title: Announcing The Next Free Expansion - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/9a934cf611869f6a2787526f38184cc0e6ee9f46.png

We're already in-testing for our next three games to join the Elephant Collection, absolutely free (no paid DLC!). And with this expansion, every single Blue Elephant made will now be united under one actual roof (and some basement parts!)

Game #1: Loot the Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/52b17cc45e03fe7ab1afeee5620857aac3ecf500.png

It's time to pick up some sweet loots and go to battle! Attack train car after train car of loot-filled bins, and take whatever you can grab onto! Grind to keep getting new weapons and upgrades. It's a fight to the bitter end. See if you can defeat all 100 train cars!

Game #2: Treadmillasaurus Rex
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/a963efd27aae4def92ef739d661212e5bba8a556.jpg

Is there an elephant? No, but as my favorite game I've ever made, I felt it had a place in The Elephant Collection. 

Okay, so this time you're a T-Rex on a treadmill. Your job: survive as long as you can. In your way are spike balls and lasers, as well as an ever-increasing speed and difficulty. Prepare to burn some calories!

The fun-fact achievements on this one are going to be hilarious, just saying.

Game #3: Elephant Rave 2
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/8c9d541f61f3f348f2c26bba2061081e7c801d53.jpg

Didn't Elephant Rave 2 just come out last year? It sure did, but now it's coming directly to the Elephant Collection! This time with achievements and little facts that will certainly make you question why you're playing this game all over again.

Rave all over again, unless you YOLO. Then, well...

Our timeline to finish these games is a little up in the air as we're going through testing, but progress has already been made and we felt positive enough about sharing our news (it should be pretty soon!). We just didn't want to keep you waiting and also we're TERRIBLE at secrets.

Thanks for all your support, also let your friends know... we're 33% off right now! That's like... the butt and back leg of the elephant absolutely free. Have a really wonderful day and thank you for all your support on The Elephant Collection!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/43b2b3ad2a0859737d5f559b13d1c85f543197a0.gif

notes.title: Year of Good Things, March Elephant Collection Update!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

First off I'm working on a project called The Year of Good Things! It's a Kickstarter that is live now, would love your support to work on twelve brand-new games in the classic Flash spirit. All the games will be wrapped up and brought to Steam in the future!

Back on Kickstarter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/20dec05d885b31dd73bdeac1c9f37aadf2998b3c.png

Second, updates on The Elephant Collection!

Our current plan is to introduce LOOT! The Game in an upcoming update. If you have never played LOOT! The Game, its a Diablo-esque train chase... with guns!? Its a little wild and my last Flash game while at Armor Games, so a bookend to my time and career at the company.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44083355/52b17cc45e03fe7ab1afeee5620857aac3ecf500.png

As we started thinking about where we should be adding games we thought about taking the elevator down... meaning we'll be adding a basement floor to the building to give us some space to add new games and achievements. Right now we're considering up to two non-elephant games to also include in the basement.

Timing for these updates are a little up in the air at the moment with part of the team out of town and the rest of us a little heads down with the Kickstarter. Like the elephant we won't forget, just got a lot of hamsters in the air right now.

If you have game suggestions for The Elephant Collection please let us know!

notes.title: v1.04 Quick fixes based on early feedback
notes.content:
Thanks for all your great early feedback players, this is a quick little update that fixes a few bugs. 

v1.04  (You can see your current version number in the top left of the screen when you first launch the game)

- If your 'Achievement Unlocked 3' Steam Achievement has not unlocked when it should have try going back into the game and it should unlock!

-A fix to allow for the ":-)" achievement on 'Achievement Unlocked 2' to be earned with some non-English Keyboards (thanks for pointing that out!)

-A fix to address a certain crash on 'Achievement Unlocked 3' if you were a bit too eagar to get into the game!

-A few other bits and pieces!

We've loved hearing from you and how lovely you all are!
